interview.hardest_part: The Community Center dependency chain: triggering its events, visiting the Wizard, obtaining bundle-specific items, and restoring rooms while also handling precise fishing, mining, inventory, and navigation tasks within three hours.
interview.likely_failure: I am most likely to lose substantial time to misclicks, imprecise movement, toolbar mistakes, and difficult fishing or mine sequences, then miss the Junimo-text and bundle milestones or pass out before saving useful progress.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Many milestones are independent and worth one point, so exploration, introductions, foraging, basic farming, shipping assorted items, and early mine progress can score without completing the Center. Menus provide time to inspect options, starting tools support several activities immediately, and shipping converts gathered items into money overnight.
interview.harmful_mechanics: The game advances while I think, days and energy are limited, and sleeping is needed for reliable saving. Crop growth, mail and event schedules, shop hours, tool-upgrade delays, fishing mechanics, random mine ladders and item drops, and seasonal bundle requirements all create delays or execution challenges.
